Deportation of illegal Bangladeshis
*121.SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM:
 SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME  AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has started any
serious attempt to send the illegal
Bangladeshi migrants back to their country;
(b) if so, the details of the attempts and
the number of migrants sent back to
Bangladesh in last six months; and
(c) how many have been deported in the
above said period from Mumbai?
Keeping of endangered animals in
farm-houses
*122. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned
"Python catch at hotelier's farm-house"
which appeared in the Hindustan Times,
New Delhi on the 10th January, 2003;
(b) if so, what are the complete details
thereof;
(c) whether Government are aware
that a large number of owners of farm -
house are keeping endangered animals;
and
(d) if so, what steps Government
propose to identify farm -houses and
capture the animals and punish the
guilty under the Wild Life Protection
Act, 1972?
Use of Aircrafts reserved for PM and
Home Minister
*123. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI R.K. ANAND:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) how many and what type of aircrafts
have been kept reserved for the use of Prime
Minister and Home Minister; and
(b) to whom these aircrafts belong to
and how are there aircrafts utilised when
Prime Minister and Home Minister does
not require it?

Completion of universal metering
*124. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH:
Will the Minister of POWER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the 11 Kv. and
above metering in the first phase was to
have been completed by the end of 2001;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
universal metering is also lagging behind
throughout the country;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) by when Government propose to
complete universal metering?
Target for employment under SGRY
and SJGSY
†*125. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set an
annual target for providing new job
opportunities in each State of the country
under Sampoorna Gramin Rojgar Yojana
and Swarn Jayanti Gram Swarojgar
Yojana;
(b) if so, the targetted number for each
State; and
(c) by when unemployment will be
eradicated completely in each State through
these schemes?
IAF aircraft crash
*126. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of IAF aircrafts which
crashed during the last two years;
(b) how many Air Force officials and
citizens lost their lives in such incidents and
loss suffered by IAF as a result thereof; and
(c) the reasons for these crashes and the
remedial steps Government have taken in
this regard?
Potable and ground water crisis in
Rajasthan
*127. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal from the Government of
Rajasthan regarding the potable and ground
water crisis faced by the State last year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount of grant extended to the
State Government against the said proposals;
and
(d) whether Government are willing to
extend concessions granted under
Accelerated Rural Water Supply Programme
in drought hit areas of the State?
Intermediate Jet Trainer developed
by HAL
*128. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:

Schemes for the welfare of handloom

the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to

(b) the details of the financial aid
provided for implementation of the above
schemes in the State during the last three
years; and
(c) the district-wise number of the
weavers benefited by these schemes?

Installation of Advanced Landing
System at Airports
627. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an Advanced
Landing System was installed recently at
Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi;
(b) if so, what was the total expense
incurred for this new system;
(c) whether Government have plans to
install simular system at all major
international airports of the country; and
(d) if so, by when?
Enhancing FDI limit for domestic
aviation
628. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to enhance the FDI limit in
domestic aviation;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that it is also
proposed to allow foreign airlines on operate
on domestic routes;
(d) if so, the details in this regard;
(e) whether reciprocal arrangement is
sought for Air India to operate in the
domestic air routes of the such countries;
and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Operation of Indian Commercial
Flights over Pakistan
629. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of Pakistan
has alowed Indian Commercial flights to
operate over its skies;
(b) if not, whether there is an increase in
passenger and cargo tariff whether for
passengers or cargo as a result thereof;
(c) if so, whether Government have
plans to negotiate with the Pakistani
authorities regarding the use of its skies for
commercial flights; and
(d) if so, the details of the negotiations
reached so far?

Notification on route rationalisation
630. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
of Civil Aviation has issued a route
rationalisation notification recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the notification is applicable
only to Indian Airlines and Air India or it
applies to private players also;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Profitt/lLosses of AI and IA
†631. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state the profits earned of losses
suffered by the Air India and the Indian
Airlines during the last three years?
Amendments in AAI Act, 1994
632. SHRI JANARDHANA POOJ-
ARY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
amend the Airports Authority of India Act,
1994 vis-a-vis the Bangalore International
Airport project; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard?
Allowing Domestic/private airlines to
fly to foreign destinations
633. SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have permitted
some domestic private airlines to fly to
foreign destinations also;
(b) if so, the reasons and justification
therefor;
(c) the benefits to accrue to the
Government on allowing domestic/private
airlines to fly foreign distinations;
(d) whether such a decision will have an
adverse impact on Air India and Indian
Airlines; and
(e) if so, the steps taken to check such
impact?
Change in names of airports
634. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether names of some Airports have
been changed;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any expense was increased
by the Airports Authority of India in issuign
advertisement in relation to change of name
of airports; and
(d) if so, the details of amount spent,
airport-wise?
Media publicity of AAI
635. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) what is the budget of Media publicity
of Airports Authority of India every year; and
(b) the amount spent by Airports
Authority of India on such media publicity
during the last three years-wise ?

SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether private individuals and
Indian Companies are debarred for the
ground handling inside the Airports; and
(b) whether it is a fact that many
companies are supplying manpower to
various Airlines for ground handling?
